subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Gussadi dance, performed by men wearing elaborate peacock-feather headgear and animal-skin costumes during the Dandari/Naga Panchami festival, is a distinctive tribal dance of which community in the Adilabad region?
explanation: The Gussadi dance is performed by Gond men (especially Raj Gonds) of the Adilabad region during the Dandari festival, distinguished by elaborate peacock-feather headdresses — distinct from the Koya (associated with Sammakka-Saralamma Jatara) or Lambadi (known for mirror-work embroidery) tribal traditions.
